description: Wildtype reference donor for CCR5 HIV resistance studies. Normal CCR5 expression, full susceptibility to R5-tropic HIV-1 strains.
Heterozygous carrier of the protective CCR5-Δ32 allele (rs333). Exhibits ~50% reduced cell-surface CCR5 receptor density and slower disease progression.

variants.clinical_significance: Protective against HIV-1 infection and progression

sample_type: CD34+ Hematopoietic Stem and Progenitor Cells (HSPCs)
description: Patient harboring a personal SNP chr3:46373140 C>T directly inside the seed region of the standard CCR5 sgRNA-1 target site. Demonstrates how individual genomic variation alters guide cleavage efficacy.
clinical_status: HIV-1 Candidate for Ex-Vivo Cell Therapy

variants.impact: Synonymous codon change in CCR5 coding exon 3; disrupts CRISPR SpCas9 seed pairing

description: Patient with Sickle Cell Disease (HbS), homozygous for the classical beta-globin Glu6Val missense mutation.

variants.impact: Missense mutation p.Glu6Val; leads to HbS polymerization under hypoxia
